Restaurant Outlet Manager Job at Jobvet Services




        
    

        
        Jobvet Services - Our client, a Reputable Restaurant in Lekki, Lagos, is recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Restaurant Outlet Manager

Job Location: Lekki, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Hospitality / Restaurant

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Oversee the daily operations of the restaurant outlet.
	Lead, supervise, and motivate front-of-house and back-of-house teams.
	Ensure exceptional customer service and guest satisfaction.
	Monitor inventory, stock levels, and ordering of supplies.
	Drive sales, control costs, and achieve operational targets.
	Enforce food safety, hygiene, and quality standards.
	Handle customer complaints professionally and implement effective solutions.
	Prepare operational reports and coordinate staff schedules.


Requirements


	 Education: Bachelor's degree or HND in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
	Experience: Minimum of 2 years of experience managing a restaurant or hospitality outlet.


Key Skills:


	Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills.
	Sound knowledge of restaurant operations, inventory management, and customer service.
	Ability to work under pressure and in a fast-paced environment.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 Monthly.

Account Bookkeeper Job at erpSoftapp




        
    

        
        erpSoftapp - We are a business consultancy firm grounded in Odoo ERP expertise. As leaders in Odoo implementation in Nigeria, we help organisations harness the full power of Odoo to improve operations and productivity.

As an award-winning Odoo partner, our priority is helping businesses unlock the full potential of their investment through a powerful and scalable solution like Odoo ERP.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Account Bookkeeper

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-time
     

            
    



Key Responsibiliities
As a Junior Bookkeeper, your primary focus will be on the accurate monitoring and recording of accounts. Your daily duties will include:


	Transaction Recording: Accurately entering daily financial transactions, including accounts payable (AP) and accounts receivable (AR), into the company's accounting software.
	Account Monitoring & Reconciliation: Regularly monitoring bank accounts, credit card statements, and general ledgers to identify discrepancies and performing routine reconciliations.
	Invoice Processing: Generating, distributing, and tracking client invoices, as well as verifying and processing vendor bills for payment.
	Financial Documentation: Organizing and maintaining physical and digital copies of receipts, invoices, and other essential financial documents to ensure compliance and audit readiness.
	Reporting Support: Assisting senior accountants in preparing basic financial reports, such as income statements and balance sheets.


Qualifications and Skills
To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following qualifications:


	 Education: An Associate’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is preferred, though equivalent practical experience will be considered.
	Experience: Minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in bookkeeping, accounting, or a related administrative role.
	Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with accounting software (such as Odoo, Xero, Quickbooks, Sage ) and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and the broader Office 365 suite.
	Accounting Knowledge: A solid, basic understanding of accounting principles, including double-entry bookkeeping and general ledger maintenance.
	Soft Skills: Exceptional attention to detail, strong organizational abilities, and excellent written and verbal communication skills.
	The ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team is essential.


Salary
N80,000 - N150,000 per month.
